findings.message: model relates column "author_id" of table "posts" to table "users", but no foreign key does that
findings.fix: Add a foreign key from column "author_id" of table "posts" to table "users": declare the relation in the model, then regenerate the migration and apply it (repair orphaned rows first).

findings.message: table "user_roles" is the join table for "users", "roles" in the model, but has no foreign key to table "roles"
findings.fix: Add a foreign key from table "user_roles" to table "roles": declare the many-to-many relation in the model so its join table references both sides, then regenerate the migration and apply it.
